summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the ownership and access rights for the company's 'Vacations' Google Calendar. Someone confirmed that all employees now have access to this calendar. A reminder was subsequently posted asking everyone to enter their planned vacation days into the designated 'Vacations' calendar.
decisions: All employees were granted access to the Vacations Google Calendar.
action_items: Employees must enter their planned vacation days into the Vacations Google Calendar.
